logoutConfirm.title: Are you sure you want to log out?
logoutConfirm.description: You will need to re-verify your institutional email address to gain access next time.

serverConfig.title: Server
serverConfig.description: The Docenti server used for sign-in, sync and official templates.
serverConfig.label: Server address
serverConfig.hint: Ask your institution for the address. You can use guest mode without one.
serverConfig.currentlyOffline: Saved, but the server isn't responding right now.
serverConfig.identityChanged: This address now answers as a different Docenti server. Save again to use it.
serverConfig.insecure: This connection isn't encrypted (http). Sign-in codes and your session can be read by others on the network. Prefer https outside a local network.

feedback.saved-unverified: Saved, but the server couldn't be reached. It will be checked again automatically.
feedback.invalid-url: That doesn't look like a valid address.
feedback.unreachable: Couldn't reach the server. Check the address and your connection.
feedback.not-docenti: Something answered at this address, but it isn't a Docenti server.

switch.title: Switch to a different server?
switch.description: This address belongs to a different Docenti server, so you'll be signed out. Your data stays on this computer and comes back if you return to the previous server.
switch.pending_one: {{count}} change hasn't been synced yet; it will be sent when you sign in to the previous server again.
switch.pending_other: {{count}} changes haven't been synced yet; they will be sent when you sign in to the previous server again.

authStatus.offlineTooltip: No connection to the server. Everything keeps working with your local data. Click to try reconnecting.
authStatus.expiredTooltip: The server no longer recognizes this session. You can keep using the app; sign in again to edit your profile.
authStatus.guestTooltip: No server account — your data stays on this computer only.
authStatus.server-mismatchTooltip: The configured server isn't the one you signed in to, so nothing is sent to it. Click to review the server in Settings, or sign out.
authStatus.no-serverTooltip: Sync is paused until a server is set. Click to configure it in Settings.

reauth.title: Sign in again
reauth.description: We'll send a 6-digit code to {{email}}. Your data and current screen won't be affected.

deleteCollection.warning: This action cannot be undone. To confirm deletion, type the exact code below:

sync.errorTooltip: The server could not apply the changes. They stay saved here and will be retried.
sync.neverSynced: Not synced with the server yet
sync.detachedRemotely: Sync was turned off on another device for: {{names}}. They stay here as local-only collections.
